subject: Orion Health pilot: ops bridge, procurement checkpoints & sponsor handoff
messages:
From: Samira Khan <skhan@orion-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@orion-health.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T13:12:00Z
Subject: Next steps for integration pilot & procurement checkpoints

Hi Monica / Laura,

Thanks for the demo today — the team found the latency and deployment flexibility compelling. Quick recap and asks from our side so we can align with procurement: 

- We want a 6-week pilot focused on EHR data summarization (PII kept in-house).
- Procurement needs a high-level SOW, cost estimate for pilot, and a template MSA to start redlines.
- Security requires SOC 2 evidence and a short note on data residency (can you confirm US-only hosting options?).

Can you send the one-pager for expected ROI and a suggested mutual action plan (timeline + owners) so I can share with our CFO and procurement lead (Carla Reyes)?

Appreciate it —
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Data Platforms | Orion Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@orion-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@orion-health.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps for integration pilot & procurement checkpoints

Samira — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise stakeholder map and an ROI one-pager. High level answers inline and next steps below.

Security & residency
- We can provision the pilot in a US-only region and provide SOC 2 type II summary and our security questionnaire (attached). Full SOC 2 report available under NDA.

Procurement items
- Attached: proposed pilot SOW (1 page) and pricing matrix. We recommend a simple fixed-fee pilot to avoid consumption variance.

Mutual action plan (MAP) — proposed owners and target dates
- Week 0 (this week): Sign pilot MSA (Carla / Laura) — target: 2027-05-28
- Week 1: Tech kickoff & environment provisioning (Ben / Orion infra) — target: 2027-06-02
- Weeks 2–5: Pilot run with checkpoints (Monica / Samira) — milestone reviews on 6/9 and 6/23
- Week 6: Results, decision recommendation (CFO / Redwood sales) — target: 2027-06-30

Attachments: redwood-stakeholder-map.pdf; redwood-roi-onepager.pdf; redwood-procurement-matrix.xlsx

Next asks for you
- Please confirm procurement contact for DocuSign route (Carla?) and any specific legal constraints (data processors, IP carve-outs).
- If Carla is the procurement lead, I will loop Laura (enterprise legal) and Ben (technical owner) on the MSA redline process.

Thanks — pulling this together now.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@orion-health.com>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps for integration pilot & procurement checkpoints

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 3:03 PM Monica Patel wrote:
> Samira — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise stakeholder map and an ROI one-pager. High level answers inline and next steps below.

Hi all — quick operational note from my side: I will lead the tech kickoff and ensure we have a minimal access pattern that respects Orion's in-house PII handling. Deliverables we will provide before kickoff:

- Tech kickoff pack (env diagram, access matrix, runbook) — delivery 2027-05-27
- Pilot instrumentation: perf dashboard + token-cost estimator for pilot scope
- ROI one-pager (attached) with conservative savings numbers and break-even model.

Also attaching a draft pricing matrix for the pilot. If legal is comfortable, we can drop a short DocuSign for the pilot MSA to Carla (monica — can you confirm Carla's email and primary legal caveats?).

Attachments: redwood-roi-onepager.pdf; redwood-procurement-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <skhan@orion-health.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Carla Reyes <carla.reyes@orion-health.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps for integration pilot & procurement checkpoints

Thanks — confirming Carla Reyes (procurement) will own contract routing (carla.reyes@orion-health.com). A couple of clarifications from procurement & security: 

- Procurement prefers a two-step DocuSign (pilot MSA then statement of work). They asked for a short playbook for how Redwood will handle data during pilot (can you provide the runbook Ben mentioned?).
- Security asked if Redwood can sign a standard DPA (we have one but will need to review). Please send SOC 2 summary and the security questionnaire.
- CFO wants the ROI one-pager and an optional pricing scenario showing a small-scale pilot vs. scaled deployment.

If you can get the runbook + SOC 2 summary + pricing scenarios to Carla and me by 2027-05-27, procurement will route the pilot MSA that same week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Samira
